metadata.description: Pretty 2-line statusline for Claude Code with per-model cost tracking, theme picker, and custom palette support.

plugins.name: claude-statusline-pretty
plugins.description: 2-line statusline showing model, dir, branch, context %, cache hit %, session duration, and per-model cost. Persistent cost tracking across sessions, race-free for concurrent windows. PowerShell on Windows, Bash + jq on macOS / Linux. Bundled themes plus a JSON-driven custom palette.
